old: A man should live even a moment by pure action, and not even an aeon by painful action opposed to both worlds.
new: A man should live even a moment by pure action, and not even a kalpa by painful action opposed to both worlds.
why: reviewer (minor): kalpa is rendered 'aeon' here but kept as 'kalpa' in unit 21 (kalpānte); one fixed rendering is needed.
reviewer (minor): Same inconsistency in the word gloss.

old: Lifespan, action and wealth and learning, and death indeed: these five are indeed created for the embodied being when he is in the womb itself.
new: Lifespan, action and wealth and learning, and death indeed: these five are indeed created for the embodied being dwelling in the womb itself.
why: reviewer (error): 'when he is' adds a temporal clause the Sanskrit lacks. garbhasthasya ... dehinaḥ is a genitive phrase (of the embodied being dwelling in the womb); the Hindi 'रहते हुए' is also temporal but acceptable.

old: अनागत का विधान करने वाला, और वैसे ही प्रत्युत्पन्नमति, ये दोनों सुख से बढ़ते हैं; 'जो होगा' वाला नष्ट होता है।
new: अनागत का विधान करने वाला, और वैसे तत्काल बुद्धि वाला, ये दोनों सुख से बढ़ते हैं; 'जो होगा' वाला नष्ट होता है।
why: reviewer (error): tathā is rendered 'वैसे ही' but there is no eva; ही is added (glossary: add ही only where eva is printed). Also the compound pratyutpanna-mati is left untranslated in the Hindi while the English translates it ('of ready wit').
reviewer (minor): Root label omits the prefix (anu-√vṛt); other prefixed verbs in the chunk carry it (ā-√śri, abhi-√vand).
reviewer (minor): The emended participle agrees with masculine abhimāne (dehābhimāna is m.), so the label 'n.' is wrong.

new: pp. of desiderative, n. nom. sg. √āp
why: reviewer (minor): īpsita is the past participle of the desiderative stem of √āp (īpsati); label should show this.

old: मन का चाहा हुआ सब कुछ, सुख, किसे प्राप्त होता है? क्योंकि सब कुछ दैव के अधीन है, इसलिए सन्तोष का आश्रय लेना चाहिए।
new: मन का चाहा हुआ सब कुछ, सुख, किसे प्राप्त होता है? क्योंकि सब कुछ भाग्य के अधीन है, इसलिए सन्तोष का आश्रय लेना चाहिए।
why: reviewer (minor): daiva = fate; the glossary renders fate as भाग्य (vidhi = fate (भाग्य)); keep one Hindi word.

old: As among thousands of cows the calf goes to the mother, so and the action that has been done follows the doer.
new: As among thousands of cows the calf goes to the mother, so, and the action that has been done follows the doer.
why: reviewer (minor): 'so and the action' is ungrammatical; the printed ca is kept but needs a comma to read.

old: जैसे हजारों गायों में बछड़ा माता के पास जाता है, वैसे और जो कर्म किया गया है, वह कर्ता का अनुसरण करता है।
new: जैसे हजारों गायों में बछड़ा माता के पास जाता है, वैसे, और जो कर्म किया गया है, वह कर्ता का अनुसरण करता है।
why: reviewer (minor): Same: comma needed to separate tathā from ca.

old: For one of unsettled work there is no happiness among people, none in the forest. People burn through contact, the forest through avoidance of company.
new: For one of unsettled work there is happiness neither among people nor in the forest. People burn through contact, the forest through avoidance of company.
why: reviewer (minor): na ... na is 'neither ... nor'; 'none in the forest' recasts the structure.

old: फावड़े से खोदकर निश्चय ही भूमि में जल पा लेता है; वैसे ही गुरु में स्थित विद्या को सेवा की इच्छा वाला प्राप्त करता है।
new: फावड़े से खोदकर निश्चय ही भूमि में जल पा लेता है; वैसे गुरु में स्थित विद्या को सेवा की इच्छा वाला प्राप्त करता है।
why: reviewer (error): tathā has no eva; 'ही' is an addition (glossary ch05: add ही only where eva is printed).
